Station Notes - MSUKBS (MSU Kellogg Biological Station) 
 
 
07/26/2023: Station Maintenance:                                        [1415] 
 
            - repaired faulty tipping-bucket rain gauge 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
06/20/2018: Station Maintenance:                                        [1230] 
 
             - faulty air temperature sensor was replaced 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
08/30/2016: Station Maintenance:                                        [1100] 
 
             - checked to ensure that both soil temperature sensors 
               are available. 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
11/15/2010: Data Notes [Raw-Data Only]:                                 [1100] 
 
             - The 10-m wind speed appears to be unavailable since 
               11/03/2010 11:00.   Wind sensors were replaced on  
               11/10/10, but some new cabling is still needed. 
 
 
04/09/2010: Data Update:                                                [1500] 
 
             - Have encountered a problem with the "daily reports" 
               during Daylight-Savings Time.   Until this problem  
               is resolved, only "hourly" and "five-minute" data 
               will be available. 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
02/20/2008: Data Correction (jb): 
 
             - With the help of KBS, modification to calculation of 
               the hourly data was applied.   Needed to download the 
               updated files and reload into the MAWN database. 
 
 
01/23/2008: Station Online: 
 
             - Station added to MAWN web site. 
 
 
01/18/2008: Data Collection Enabled: 
 
             - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins: 
 
                  First data report:   Dec 01, 2007 - 00:05 (Day=335) 
 
 
01/17/2008: Data Collection: 
 
             - Final Testing of automated data-collection and data-format 
               changes (with the help of Sven Bohn from KBS). 
 
             - Should now able to collect raw weather data in proper format. 
 
 
Fall 2007: New Station Retro-Fitted for MAWN Network (sm): 
 
                Notes: 
                  
                   Will not be able to current wind data.   Sensor at 
                   MSUKBS is installed at 10-m.   MAWN Network requires 
                   wind data at 3-m. 
 
                   Soil Moisture Data reported at slightly different  
                   depths: 
 
                      MSTR0:   KBS (5cm)    MAWN (10cm) 
                      MSTR1:   KBS (20cm)   MAWN (25cm)
